privileged_info_for_vlm: The ground station must be named 'MSI_Chicago' (Lat: 41.7906, Lon: -87.583, Alt: 181). The module must be named 'Crewed_Missions' and contain exactly two satellites: ISS ZARYA (25544) and CSS TIANHE (48274). The layout must be 'Map-only'. Ground tracks must be visible for 2 orbits. All other modules (like the default 'Amateur') must be closed. The final state must be full-screen.
